extension.name: Node Health History
extension.description: Periodically records the reachability and system information of every wings node, and charts the recent history on an admin page.
extension.author: M12Labs

settingsSchema.label: Poll interval (minutes)
settingsSchema.help: How often each node's health is sampled. Takes effect on the next scheduler run after saving.

settingsSchema.label: Retention (days)
settingsSchema.help: Snapshots older than this are pruned during each poll.
